This was probably the worst service I have experienced at a Hilton property in the 28 years I have been staying with you.

Totally forgetable experience.

2.5 hours late having our connecting room ready. Very difficult when you are traveling with a 14 month old and a 4 month old.

I walked up to my room, saw that it was clean and my name was on the TV as a welcome through the window. I went down stairs and had to request a key to get in. I was not contacted despite waiting.

Once in, the air did not work properly. I had to keep the doors to the connecting room open to cool the room with broken air.

I called a day in advance and requested a pack and play be in the room. Someone contacted me.via text, and said it woyld not be a problem. I asked again at check in. It took 4 hours to get a pack and play and I had to request it four times. The pack and play was pretty dirty and had stains on it. I was limited on space in the car, I will find a way to fit my own next time. It turned in to a huge hastle. That was the first and last time I tried to take advantage of that service.

The rooms smell like mildew. They really do, I am not just piling it on.

The manager was nice enough, but it was not a well run hotel.

There was a giant parade there. I was not informed of this when booking and no one called ahead. In the past they have been kind enough to do this. Many of the roads around the hotel were closed off. It was a complete nightmare. We spent 45 minutes going up and down one way streets just trying to get to the entrance. They reached out to welcome me prior to arrival that morning. Why not warn us and give us some directions on how to get around all the barracades? It just does not make sense.

Plenty of other properties to stay at. People need to stay away from this place.

Do not stay here. It is unsafe, unclean, and not maintained at even a basic level.

I am a heart attack survivor of 7 months. I am also in heart failure. I sought out this property in search of peace and solitude, but what I found instead was a monster in the gates of hell. The General Manager of this property prioritizes room inspections over providing a pleasant experience, and stay. I asked her several times to fix my TV, and she never did. Instead she came for a room inspection. I dont like strangers in my room, but I didn't mind because I'm a pretty clean and organized person. When she came in I pointed out the TV once more, and I also mentioned my recent heart attack and pointed out the meds to emphasize that I needed rest and recovery. She walked away mid sentence. Then a few days later I received a notice stating that my room was too cluttered and my service animal is a safety and health violation. WOW!!! After I confronted her about it, she then proceeded to call the Sheriff and trespass me, and she even threatened to have me arrested. She ejected me from my room, in the middle of the day. I explained that I needed time due to my physical limitations. I cannot lift more than 10 pounds. She told the Sheriff to tell me that if I wasn't gone in 1 hour, she would keep my remaining paid days, and my security deposit. She put my health at risk over a power trip.

text.text:
I do not write reviews lightly, but I feel obligated to share this experience due to significant safety and cleanliness concerns.

My fiancé and I stayed here while attending a ceremony honoring my late father for being recognized as an organ donor. We needed a safe and comfortable place during an already emotional weekend. Unfortunately, that was not our experience.

Check-In & First Impressions
The check-in process was unprofessional and uncomfortable. The front desk associate provided no information about the property or how to locate our room. No credit card was requested for incidentals despite the reservation being prepaid through Expedia. When asking about my fiancé staying in the room, he awkwardly requested his full name without explanation, which felt unnecessary and poorly handled.

The lobby restrooms were closed to the public, and used napkins remained on the entrance table for nearly two days. The elevator (there is only one) had a strong odor and visible dust buildup.

Security & Environment Concerns
It became apparent that there are long-term residents living at this property — something not disclosed at the time of booking. There was a heavy volume of people coming and going in the hallways at various hours. Individuals appeared to be visiting rooms without any visible registration or oversight. The front desk was frequently unattended, and the lobby door was often left open, allowing unrestricted access to the building.

The second floor consistently smelled of marijuana and cigarette smoke despite posted no-smoking signs. Dogs barked regularly, and there was a lingering odor of garbage in the hallway. These conditions were not addressed during our stay.

For paying guests expecting a standard hotel environment, the lack of controlled access and visible staff presence created a genuine sense of vulnerability and concern for personal safety.

Room Conditions
The air conditioning and television functioned — those were the only positives.

The room had a noticeable pet urine odor. The bathroom contained hair that was not ours. The kitchen sink repeatedly backed up, releasing a foul smell from the drain. The window frame was broken. The bed was extremely firm and uncomfortable, and the pillows were small and unsupportive. The carpet appeared worn and questionable in cleanliness.

Given the lack of professionalism and staff presence from the start, I did not feel confident that raising concerns would result in resolution.

Transparency Matters
The photos on Expedia and Google do not accurately reflect the current condition or atmosphere of this property. When booking as part of a travel bundle, this hotel is presented as a budget-friendly and convenient option near central Florida attractions. There is no transparency indicating the presence of long-term residents or the level of security oversight.

This stay added unnecessary stress to an already difficult weekend. We left feeling disappointed, uncomfortable, and concerned about the lack of basic hotel safety standards.

I strongly encourage greater transparency so future guests can make informed decisions

My daughter stayed here for about a month, but I paid for the stay and the deposit—and the experience was extremely frustrating, especially when it came to getting my money back.

At check-in, the deposit was originally stated as $50, then changed to $100. The staff member (I believe her name was Tiffany) processed it as a purchase instead of a deposit, which caused issues later. At checkout, we were initially told there was no deposit at all—despite me having proof from my credit card and receipt.

I was then told it would take 3 days to receive my refund. After 8 days, nothing had been returned, and my bank confirmed there was no pending refund. When I reviewed the paperwork, it showed the refund had been sent to a different card that I did not use.

When I went back to the hotel, I spoke with the manager, general manager, and another staff member (Lisa). The situation was not handled professionally. I was given conflicting explanations, including being told that Booking.com had my deposit—which they confirmed was not true. Eventually, the general manager stated he corrected the error and reprocessed the refund to the correct card, but only after I had to come in person and push for answers. I did call my bank and they stated there is still no refund. I will be keeping an eye on it and will escalate it further if needed to get my refund.
I do not feel it takes 3 people attacking you to get it resolved and Lisa is not very friendly, staff talk down on you knowing there not being honest to try to convince you otherwise. That is why I was able to verify with other company’s today the information they provided was false.

** I also became aware that I am not the only customer who has had issues receiving their deposit back, which is concerning.

Beyond the billing issue:
•	The room did not match the photos advertised
•	Housekeeping was inconsistent and did not stay on top of basic cleaning
•	There were cleanliness issues during the stay, including bugs in the room
•	Key cards frequently stopped working and had to be reset multiple times

Overall, this was a stressful experience. A simple deposit return turned into multiple trips, conflicting information, and unnecessary delays. I would not recommend staying here.

Would give no stars if I could
